# I Am To Work

> Build Faster. Automate Smarter. Grow with AI.

I Am To Work is a technology and marketing agency that helps businesses build modern websites, automate repetitive workflows, create better content, and implement practical AI solutions.

## Services
1. **Website Building**: Modern, responsive Next.js websites built for real business goals (Landing pages, business websites, restaurant websites).
2. **Business Automation**: Automating repetitive work and business processes using tools like n8n and Make.
3. **AI Content & Design**: Professional content writing, copywriting, and design powered by AI tools.
4. **AI Marketing & Growth**: Creating content systems, lead generation flows, and marketing automation to consistently drive growth.

## Contact Information
- **Email**: vivekp@iamtowork.com
- **Website**: https://iamtowork.com

## Philosophy
Practical solutions focused on real business outcomes, not complicated tech for the sake of it. Fast delivery, transparent processes, and all-in-one expertise.
